free_tier.stated: Uploading and downloading are 100% free; the upgrade page lists Unlimited Storage on the free tier; free or non-account files are kept 120 days; each file must be under 5 GB.

per_object_cap.stated: 5 GB per file for free or non-account uploads; 11 GB on premium per the FAQ, 10.80 GB per the upgrade page

retention.stated: 120 days for free or non-account files; unlimited on premium

egress.terms: Premium is $9.00 for 7 days and removes adverts; the benefits list says no download limits and maximum download speed. No free download volume is published.

interface_detail: Web upload; no API page was read.
tooling: Browser upload; no client or API documented on the pages read.
chaining: A 5 GB-per-file drop with a 120-day clock; the only paid tier is a $9.00 seven-day premium.

limits.value: 5 GB per file for free or non-account uploads; 11 GB per file on premium (FAQ) versus 10.80 GB (upgrade page)
free or non-account files are kept 120 days

binding_note: The 5 GB per-file ceiling is the first limit a large object meets; the 120-day clock is second.

identity_cost.detail: The home page Upload button (/register_non_user) opens a temp account with no email address: it shows 66.8 MB of storage, its uploads are public, and it is removed after 7 days unless registered. A full account needs an email address (the password is sent to it) and a reCAPTCHA, or Login with Google. Premium is bought from an upgrade page with a contact address for payment problems.

reliability_note: The FAQ and the upgrade page disagree on the premium per-file cap (11 GB versus 10.80 GB).
confidence_note: Limits and the $9.00 price read on the vendor FAQ and upgrade pages. The registration form fields and the payment methods are unread.
